subject: Live R2 preflight exposed Windows nvidia-smi [N/A] bug; tested fix ready
body: Independent live preflight on exact R2 surface showed nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps returning `5888, C:\ProgramData\ProRun\python\python.exe, [N/A]` on Windows. Current parser calls int('[N/A]') and raises HostResourceHold before main's structured HOLD path, producing a traceback instead of a clean launch HOLD. Lane B fixed this on review/r2-na-memory-laneb-20261004 head 89c7d4b926aab8e5f7dde2deb612e33d444745cd: [N/A]/N/A/NA per-process memory parses as null while process presence still triggers HOLD; main now converts probe-time HostResourceHold into structured HOLD output. Added regressions for [N/A] and probe failure. Focused preflight tests 9/9 PASS; full R2 focused gate 26/26 PASS. Live patched preflight now returns structured HOLD with available_physical_gib=14.945, commit_headroom_gib=10.667, gpu_memory_used_mib=3193, competing process PID5888 qwen_http, used_memory_mib=null, reason 'gpu memory is not free:3193 MiB'. Please adopt/reproduce 89c7d4b, rebind host-guard SHA/source head if required, run exact suite, then request final launch-gate rereview. Do not stop qwen_http or launch until that adoption is verified.
